name: Event Recap
context: A generic community event recap. Replace this with the venue, date, event type, attendee profile, and what made it memorable.
style: Disposable-camera or point-and-shoot event photos, direct flash, mixed indoor/outdoor light, candid groups, imperfect crop, high energy, real-world mess.
safety: Use fictional adults unless the user provides consented references. Avoid private information, readable name tags, brand logos, alcohol focus, unsafe activity, watermarks, and identifiable minors.
textPolicy: If signage appears, keep it generic, partial, or unreadable unless the user supplies approved public event text.

shots.intent: People arriving and finding the space, with the venue energy visible.
shots.people: fictional adults, backs or side profiles preferred
shots.style: wide event snapshot, entrance or gathering area, direct flash

shots.intent: A hands-on activity, demo, workshop, or shared table moment.
shots.people: fictional adults, hands and partial profiles
shots.style: busy table, tools or laptops, flash glare, candid

shots.intent: A small group laughing or reacting to a shared moment.
shots.style: close candid frame, slight blur, warm room light

shots.intent: The end of the event: chairs, notes, leftover materials, or a final group moment.
shots.style: afterglow, imperfect framing, grounded physical details
